lessons.keep: Start with a specific human situation that explains why the workflow matters.
lessons.avoid: Avoid letting testimonials replace a readable task start and completion check.
lessons.open: Retrieval setup, record completeness, exception handling, customer metrics, volume claims and all audio remain unverified.
try: Open a Tin film with a launch owner missing campaign assets, then show the exact collection request and delivered set.
Pair a customer speed claim with a visible before-and-after case timeline and a clear measurement scope.
